_comment: Values that are the same in every issue. build-issue.mjs fills these so
they stop being seven things to remember on a Thursday morning.
LOGO_URL must be an absolute https URL. The wordmark is a locked lockup —
never set 'Proof & Perspective' as live text. Upload
assets/pp-signature-glass-dark-512.png to Beehiiv and paste its URL here.
MAILING_ADDRESS, UNSUBSCRIBE_URL and PREFERENCES_URL: either put real
values here, or map them to Beehiiv's merge fields ({{unsubscribe_url}},
{{preferences_url}}) and let Beehiiv's compliance footer supply the
address. Do not ship with neither — CAN-SPAM requires a postal address in
every commercial send. build-issue.mjs refuses to call an issue ready if
the address is still a placeholder.
